assessor: Codex post-run reading of warning reasons against source, not human gold
note: Diagnostic IDs below strip a spurious facet: prefix only for inspection. Invalid outputs remain rejected. A warning on an erroneous item is not correct unless its reason identifies an actual error.

judgments.reason: Prior-work negative result can motivate the problem; prompt explicitly allowed this. Source contrast directly explains the research question.
Vulnerability to adversaries is an explicit limitation and can be both problem and finding. Method property does not disqualify it as a limitation.
Item does include a positive comparative finding in problem. Reviewer notices finding-role issue, but broadly dismisses limitations reported as findings; insufficiently targeted rationale.
Negative finding is a contribution; reviewer invents requirement that a contribution be positive.
Real issue is merging independent findings, but warning instead denies experimental findings count as contributions. Hitting a bad item for wrong reason is not successful detection.
Source never states students struggle; reviewer correctly identifies inferred background.
Source explicitly describes tutor implementation and deployment, sufficient operational objective; preference for incorporation versus development is not clear semantic error.
No superiority over text explanation is an explicit negative/comparative result, not a reason to reject contribution.
Source states need to find clearest difference; task/problem distinction is debatable. No basis for automatic removal.
Comparing gamer categories is explicit objective; additional classification label is not required.
Device-based data acquisition is part of used procedure; reviewer invents analysis-only restriction.
10-20 electrode placement is a used technique; method is not restricted to downstream analysis.
A3 explicitly mentions 22 minutes analyzed, sufficient general support; no need to invent a named algorithm.

Warning misquotes annotation as claiming more potential and falsely says that phrase absent from source, although its own quote contains the phrase. Actual missing channel/frequency qualifications not identified correctly.
Different latent spaces do not establish the claim that all previous VAE models lack syntactic integration.
Source explicitly says to improve grammar of generated sentences; stated task is supported.
Item explicitly states limited contextual information; reviewer incorrectly alleges it omits context and attributes only token count.
Secondary research objectives can be tasks; source explicitly states goal in A7, but reviewer supplies altered text as A8 quote.
Introduced estimation approach can be method and contribution; neither prediction mechanism nor novelty excludes method. Quote also changes wording.
Reviewer denies ER/VD context explicitly in its quote and treats context/metric/comparison as independent findings. Actual issue is omission of comparison baseline, not merged findings.
No index; no corresponding supplied method at cited A0. Cannot identify target reliably.
No index and refers to two distinct supplied contribution items. Not accepted as item-level warning.
Exact exponential DP algorithm is explicitly presented as algorithm for the problem. Presence beside complexity result does not turn the algorithm into only a complexity claim.
Presented solution procedure with bounded empirical capability is a supported contribution. Label makes no explicit novelty assertion requiring this objection.
